-- Typed syntax and bound logical plan. JSON is used only for wire values.
import Json (..)
import Data.String (..)
import Data.List (..)
import Data.Foldable (all, length)

pub effect Domain
  never reject(String) : Unit

pub fn demand(b : Bool, code : String) : Unit =
  if not(b) then
    reject(code)

pub fn arr(j : Json) : List(Json) =
  match j of
    JArr(xs) => xs
    _ =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      []

pub fn text(j : Json) : String =
  match j of
    JStr(s) => s
    _ =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      ""

pub fn integer(j : Json) : Int =
  match j of
    JInt(n) => n
    _ => 0

pub fn truth(j : Json) : Bool =
  match j of
    JBool(b) => b
    _ => false

pub fn getfield(j : Json, key : String) : Json =
  match j of
    JObj(xs) => lookup_field(xs, key)
    _ =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      JNull

fn lookup_field(xs : List((String, Json)), key : String) : Json =
  match xs of
    Nil =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      JNull
    Cons((k, v), rest) =>
      if k == key then
        v
      else
        lookup_field(rest, key)

pub fn fields(j : Json, names : List(String)) : Unit =
  match j of
    JObj(xs) =>
      demand(length(xs) == length(names), "INVALID_INPUT")
      demand(
          all(
              \(name) -> length(filter(\(kv) -> fst(kv) == name, xs)) == 1,
              names,
            ),
          "INVALID_INPUT",
        )
    _ => reject("INVALID_INPUT")

pub fn reserved(s : String) : Bool =
  elem(
      to_upper(s),
      split(
          32,
          "SELECT DISTINCT AS FROM INNER JOIN LEFT OUTER ON WHERE GROUP BY HAVING ORDER ASC DESC NULLS FIRST LAST LIMIT OFFSET AND OR NOT IS NULL TRUE FALSE COALESCE COUNT SUM MIN MAX",
        ),
    )

pub fn letter(c : Int) : Bool = c >= 97 && c <= 122 || c == 95

pub fn digit(c : Int) : Bool = c >= 48 && c <= 57

pub fn name_ok(s : String) : Bool =
  byte_len(s) > 0
    && letter(byte_at(s, 0))
    && all(
        \(i) -> letter(byte_at(s, i)) || digit(byte_at(s, i)),
        range(0, byte_len(s)),
      )
    && not(reserved(s))

pub fn value_type(v : Json) : String =
  match v of
    JInt(_) => "int"
    JBool(_) => "bool"
    JStr(_) => "text"
    _ => "invalid"

pub type Column = Column {
  name: String,
  kind: String,
  qualifier: String,
  source: Int,
  index: Int,
  nullable: Bool
}

pub type Table = Table {
  name: String,
  columns: List(Column),
  rows: List(List(Json))
}

pub type Expr = Expr {
  op: String,
  value: Json,
  qualifier: String,
  name: String,
  args: List(Expr),
  kind: String,
  index: Int,
  source: Int,
  nullable: Bool
}

pub fn node(op : String, args : List(Expr)) : Expr =
  Expr {
    op = op,
    value = JNull,
    qualifier = "",
    name = "",
    args = args,
    kind = "",
    index = -1,
    source = -1,
    nullable = false
  }

pub fn literal(v : Json) : Expr =
  let typ = value_type(v)
  let nul = typ == "invalid"
  Expr { ..node("lit", []), value = v, kind = if nul then "null" else typ, nullable = nul }

pub fn column_ref(q : String, n : String) : Expr =
  Expr { ..node("col", []), qualifier = q, name = n }

pub fn agg(op : String) : Bool = elem(op, ["COUNT", "SUM", "MIN", "MAX"])

pub fn at(xs : List(a), i : Int) : a =
  match nth(i, xs) of
    Some(x) => x
    None => at(xs, i)

pub type Query = Query {
  select: List((Expr, String)),
  sources: List((String, String)),
  joins: List((Expr, Bool)),
  predicate: Expr,
  groups: List(Expr),
  having: Expr,
  has_having: Bool,
  order: List((String, Bool, Int)),
  distinct: Bool,
  limit: Int,
  offset: Int
}

pub type Plan = Plan {
  query: Query,
  tables: List(Table),
  filters: List(List(Expr)),
  aggregate: Bool,
  order: List((Int, Bool, Int))
}

pub fn validate_table(j : Json) : Table =
  fields(j, ["name", "columns", "rows"])
  let n = text(getfield(j, "name"))
  demand(name_ok(n), "INVALID_INPUT")
  let cs = map(validate_column, arr(getfield(j, "columns")))
  demand(length(cs) > 0, "INVALID_INPUT")
  demand(unique(map(\(c) -> c.name, cs)), "INVALID_INPUT")
  let rows = map(arr, arr(getfield(j, "rows")))
  for row in sof(rows) do
    demand(length(row) == length(cs), "INVALID_INPUT")
    for i in srange(0, length(cs)) do
      let col = at(cs, i)
      let vt = value_type(at(row, i))
      demand((vt == "invalid" && col.nullable) || vt == col.kind, "INVALID_INPUT")
  Table { name = n, columns = cs, rows = rows }

fn validate_column(j : Json) : Column =
  fields(j, ["name", "type", "nullable"])
  let n = text(getfield(j, "name"))
  let t = text(getfield(j, "type"))
  demand(name_ok(n) && elem(t, ["int", "text", "bool"]), "INVALID_INPUT")
  match getfield(j, "nullable") of
    JBool(b) => ()
    _ => reject("INVALID_INPUT")
  Column {
    name = n,
    kind = t,
    qualifier = "",
    source = 0,
    index = 0,
    nullable = truth(getfield(j, "nullable"))
  }

pub fn unique(xs : List(String)) : Bool =
  match xs of
    Nil => true
    Cons(x, rest) => not(elem(x, rest)) && unique(rest)

pub fn elem(x : a, xs : List(a)) : Bool given Eq(a) =
  match xs of
    Nil => false
    Cons(y, rest) => x == y || elem(x, rest)

fn tree_any(p : (Expr) -> Bool, e : Expr) : Bool =
  p(e) || any(\(a) -> tree_any(p, a), e.args)

defs.name: grouped
defs.source:
fn grouped(e : Expr, keys : List(Int)) : Unit =
  if not(agg(e.op)) && e.op /= "IS_NULL" && e.op /= "IS_NOT_NULL" && e.op /= "COALESCE" then
    demand(e.op /= "col" || elem(e.index, keys), "INVALID_AGGREGATION")
    for a in sof(e.args) do
      grouped(a, keys)

defs.source:
fn alias_index(names : List(String), n : String, i : Int) : Int =
  match names of
    Nil =>
      reject("UNKNOWN_COLUMN")
      -1
    Cons(a, rest) =>
      if a == n then
        i
      else
        alias_index(rest, n, i + 1)

defs.name: compare_value
defs.source:
fn compare_value(a : Json, b : Json) : Int =
  match (a, b) of
    (JInt(x), JInt(y)) => if x < y then -1 elif x > y then 1 else 0
    (JStr(x), JStr(y)) => str_cmp(x, y)
    (JBool(x), JBool(y)) => if x == y then 0 elif x then 1 else -1
    _ => 0

defs.name: is_null
defs.source:
fn is_null(v : Json) : Bool =
  match v of
    JNull => true
    _ => false

defs.name: evaluate
defs.source:
fn evaluate(e : Expr, row : List(Json), group : List(List(Json))) : Json =
  let op = e.op
  if op == "lit" then
    e.value
  elif op == "col" then
    at(row, e.index)
  elif op == "IS_NULL" then
    JBool(is_null(evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, group)))
  elif op == "IS_NOT_NULL" then
    JBool(not(is_null(evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, group))))
  elif op == "COALESCE" then
    coalesce_eval(e.args, row, group)
  elif agg(op) then
    evaluate_agg(e, op, group)
  else
    evaluate_binary(e, row, group)

defs.name: evaluate_agg
count_non_null
eval_agg_non_null
defs.source:
fn eval_agg_non_null(op : String, vals : List(Json)) : Json =
  if op == "SUM" then JInt(sum(map(integer, vals))) else extremum(vals, op == "MIN")

defs.name: coalesce_eval
extremum
defs.source:
fn extremum(vs : List(Json), minimum : Bool) : Json =
  match vs of
    Nil => JNull
    Cons(v, Nil) => v
    Cons(v, rest) =>
      let b = extremum(rest, minimum)
      if (compare_value(v, b) < 0) == minimum then v else b

fn evaluate_not(a : Json) : Json =
  if is_null(a) then JNull else JBool(not(truth(a)))

defs.source:
fn evaluate_plus(a : Json, b : Json) : Json =
  if is_null(a) || is_null(b) then JNull else JInt(integer(a) + integer(b))

fn evaluate_minus(a : Json, b : Json) : Json =
  if is_null(a) || is_null(b) then JNull else JInt(integer(a) - integer(b))

fn evaluate_mult(a : Json, b : Json) : Json =
  if is_null(a) || is_null(b) then JNull else JInt(integer(a) * integer(b))

fn conjuncts(e : Expr) : List(Expr) =
  if e.op == "AND" then append(conjuncts(at(e.args, 0)), conjuncts(at(e.args, 1))) else [e]

defs.source:
fn join_rows_inner(left : List(List(Json)), right : List(List(Json)), on : Expr) : List(List(Json)) =
  flatten(map(\(l) -> filter(\(r) -> truth(evaluate(on, append(l, r), [])), map(\(r) -> append(l, r), right)), left))

defs.name: join_rows_left
defs.source:
fn join_rows_left(left : List(List(Json)), right : List(List(Json)), on : Expr, right_cols : Int) : List(List(Json)) =
  flatten(map(\(l) -> let matched = filter(\(r) -> truth(evaluate(on, append(l, r), [])), map(\(r) -> append(l, r), right)) in if length(matched) > 0 then matched else [append(l, replicate(right_cols, JNull))], left))

defs.name: Group
defs.source: type Group = Group { key: String, rows: List(List(Json)) }

defs.name: add_group
defs.source:
fn add_group(gs : List(Group), key : String, row : List(Json)) : List(Group) =
  match gs of
    Nil => [Group { key = key, rows = [row] }]
    Cons(g, rest) => if g.key == key then Cons(Group { ..g, rows = append(g.rows, [row]) }, rest) else Cons(g, add_group(rest, key, row))

project
defs.source:
fn project(q : Query, row : List(Json), group : List(List(Json))) : List(List(Json)) =
  if truth(evaluate(q.having, row, group)) then [map(\(s) -> evaluate(fst(s), row, group), q.select)] else []

defs.name: distinct_rows
defs.source:
fn distinct_rows(rows : List(List(Json)), seen : List(String)) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => []
    Cons(r, rest) => let key = encode(JArr(r)) in if elem(key, seen) then distinct_rows(rest, seen) else Cons(r, distinct_rows(rest, Cons(key, seen)))

defs.name: row_compare
insert_row
defs.source:
fn insert_row(r : List(Json), rows : List(List(Json)), order : List((Int, Bool, Int))) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => [r]
    Cons(x, rest) => if row_compare(r, x, order) <= 0 then Cons(r, rows) else Cons(x, insert_row(r, rest, order))

defs.name: sort_rows
defs.source:
fn sort_rows(rows : List(List(Json)), order : List((Int, Bool, Int))) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => []
    Cons(r, rest) => insert_row(r, sort_rows(rest, order), order)

defs.name: scan_string
defs.source:
fn scan_string(s : String, i : Int, acc : String) : (String, Int) =
  demand(i < byte_len(s), "PARSE_ERROR")
  if byte_at(s, i) == 39 then
    if i + 1 < byte_len(s) && byte_at(s, i + 1) == 39 then
      scan_string(s, i + 2, concat(acc, "'"))
    else
      (acc, i + 1)
  else
    scan_string(s, i + 1, concat(acc, str_of_char(chr(byte_at(s, i)))))

defs.name: scan_word
defs.source:
fn scan_word(s : String, i : Int, numbers : Bool) : Int =
  if i >= byte_len(s) then
    i
  else
    let c = byte_at(s, i)
    if (digit(c) || not(numbers) && (letter(c) || c >= 65 && c <= 90)) then
      scan_word(s, i + 1, numbers)
    else
      i

defs.name: lex
defs.source:
fn lex(s : String, i : Int) : List(Token) =
  if i >= byte_len(s) then
    [tok("$END")]
  else
    let c = byte_at(s, i)
    if elem(c, [32, 9, 10, 13]) then
      lex(s, i + 1)
    elif c == 39 then
      let (v, j) = scan_string(s, i + 1, "")
      Cons(Token { word = "LITERAL", value = JStr(v) }, lex(s, j))
    elif digit(c) then
      let j = scan_word(s, i, true)
      let n =
        match parse_int(slice(s, i, j)) of
          Some(v) => v
          None => 0
      Cons(Token { word = "NUMBER", value = JInt(n) }, lex(s, j))
    elif letter(c) || c >= 65 && c <= 90 then
      let j = scan_word(s, i, false)
      let w = slice(s, i, j)
      Cons(tok(if reserved(w) then to_upper(w) else w), lex(s, j))
    else
      let two = slice(s, i, min(i + 2, byte_len(s)))
      if elem(two, ["<>", "<=", ">="]) then
        Cons(tok(two), lex(s, i + 2))
      else
        demand(
            elem(c, [40, 41, 44, 46, 59, 43, 45, 42, 61, 60, 62]),
            "PARSE_ERROR",
          )
        Cons(tok(str_of_char(chr(c))), lex(s, i + 1))

fn precedence(op : String) : Int =
  if op == "OR" then
    1
  elif op == "AND" then
    2
  elif elem(op, ["=", "<>", "<", ">", "<=", ">="]) then
    4
  elif elem(op, ["+", "-"]) then
    5
  elif op == "*" then
    6
  else
    0

defs.name: expression
defs.source:
fn expression(minimum : Int) : Expr =
  let t = pop()
  let w = t.word
  let e =
    if w == "NOT" then
      node("NOT", [expression(3)])
    elif w == "IS" then
      reject("PARSE_ERROR")
      node("col", [])
    elif w == "NULL" then
      literal(JNull)
    elif w == "COALESCE" then
      expect("(")
      let args = coalesce_args()
      expect(")")
      node("COALESCE", args)
    elif w == "(" then
      let x = expression(1)
      expect(")")
      x
    elif w == "-" then
      literal(JInt(-natural()))
    elif elem(w, ["NUMBER", "LITERAL"]) then
      literal(t.value)
    elif elem(w, ["TRUE", "FALSE"]) then
      literal(JBool(w == "TRUE"))
    elif agg(w) then
      expect("(")
      let args =
        if w == "COUNT" && accept("*") then
          []
        else
          [expression(1)]
      expect(")")
      node(w, args)
    else
      demand(name_ok(w), "PARSE_ERROR")
      if accept(".") then
        column_ref(w, name())
      else
        column_ref("", w)
  binary(e, minimum, false)

defs.name: query
defs.source:
fn query() : Query =
  expect("SELECT")
  let distinct = accept("DISTINCT")
  let sels = selections()
  expect("FROM")
  let (ss, js) = join_sources([source()], [])
  let pred =
    if accept("WHERE") then
      expression(1)
    else
      literal(JBool(true))
  let groups =
    if accept("GROUP") then
      expect("BY")
      group_keys()
    else
      []
  let hh = accept("HAVING")
  let hav =
    if hh then
      expression(1)
    else
      literal(JBool(true))
  let order =
    if accept("ORDER") then
      expect("BY")
      order_keys()
    else
      []
  let lim =
    if accept("LIMIT") then
      natural()
    else
      -1
  let off =
    if lim >= 0 && accept("OFFSET") then
      natural()
    else
      0
  let ignored = accept(";")
  demand(peek() == "$END", "PARSE_ERROR")
  Query {
    select = sels,
    sources = ss,
    joins = js,
    predicate = pred,
    groups = groups,
    having = hav,
    has_having = hh,
    order = order,
    distinct = distinct,
    limit = lim,
    offset = off
  }

  JObj([("ok", JBool(false)), ("error", JObj([("code", JStr(code))]))])

defs.name: decode_work
defs.source:
fn decode_work(line : String) : Json =
  match decode_lossy(line) of
    Ok(request) => choose_handler(request)
    Err(_) => error_response("INVALID_INPUT")
